# Approved research plan - model-evaluation expansion

Status: approved by research leadership on 2026-10-08.

This plan expands model-evaluation work during the current planning period. The evaluation harness
is complete, so the larger evaluation sweeps start this period instead of next period.

This plan supersedes the earlier email thread that proposed pushing the expansion to next period.

Scope: additional benchmark suites, red-team evaluation runs, and regression sweeps on each model
update. Exact token volumes are not yet known; they depend on how many model updates ship.
